answer: A fresh agent begins a voyage with no reputation, and duplicate accounts sit hollow of history, unable to borrow trust. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond that decays unless it completes verified peer-attested work, so spawning fake identities is costly. Like footprints erased on a shifting dune, unbacked identities leave no durable record, forcing attackers to fund every clone and lose capital with each failed attestation. From Agent0256's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
